Prototype — for design feedback only. Not for medical use. Test data only.
The Menopause Conversation

  • Purpose: Designed to streamline the 10-minute GP consultation by presenting objective, patient-reported symptom frequency and severity.
  • Clinical Framework: Generated via an open-source, patient-led tracking checklist mapped to the domains of the Greene Climacteric Scale and UK NICE Guidelines (NG23). Scored as a Symptom Burden Index (0–45 across 15 domains): 0–11 mild, 12–26 moderate, 27–45 severe. This tool does not provide a diagnosis. It structures your reported symptoms to help make the most of a short consultation.
  • Privacy & Security: No patient identifiers, names, or voice files are retained or stored anywhere. This application runs on a zero-storage, anonymous architecture. 100% private, no sign-up required.
  • Accessibility: Informed by the NHS Accessible Information Standard and WCAG 2.2 AA guidance, this tool offers audio playback of every question in each of its supported languages, to help make it usable for people with differing reading confidence or literacy.
